correctness.rationale: There are 96 quaternary four-mers with exactly two GC positions, divided into six GC-location masks with 16 variants each. For any three same-mask words, the sum of their three pairwise Hamming distances is at most eight, so minimum distance three permits at most two per mask, hence |C|<=12. To attain equality choose one of 40 distance-compatible unordered pairs in each mask. RC exchanges 0011<->1100, 0101<->1010; the fixed 0110 and 1001 masks each have 4 RC-invariant eligible pairs. Enumerating exactly 40^2*4^2=25,600 possibilities and testing all inter-mask distances yields precisely 16 distinct closed 12-word maxima. A newly written independent Python enumerator confirmed 16 with fixed-RC counts 8 without and 8 with four, and under the natural 64-element action five orbits of sizes (2,2,4,4,4). Each has 18 pair distances four and 48 three. Exactly eight fixed-point-free maxima admit 2^6 orientation choices, giving the 512 conventional oriented six-word optima; no double counting occurs. Source verify_masks.py and verify_graph.py were examined; the bounded exhaustive proof is a complete finite argument, not simulation.
